Class Agency

java.lang.Object
ca.bcit.realstate.Agency
public class Agency extends Object
Represents a real estate agency that manages a collection of properties. Provides functionality for adding, removing, and querying properties based on various criteria.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Noli Guerrero (A00871068)
